CAPTURE.INTRO_TEXT: Turn slowly following the dots on screen. When the reticle sits inside a dot, hold still until the ring completes — that angle gets captured.
CAPTURE.TRIPOD_HINT: Hold the phone upright and turn around the phone itself, not around your body: keep the camera still in the air and rotate about it. Moving the phone away from the turning axis is what ruins the result — at arm's length the error is five times larger. A plain tripod helps but does not settle it: it turns the camera about the screw, not about the lens.

CAPTURE.LENS_COST_LEGEND: Whatever the lens cannot reach is filled in by software, with no real detail. Less is better.
